enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, light off, phone on charge at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Turn off light. Place phone on desk charger. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Remain still. Occasionally shift position. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Wash face, brush teeth, take morning chronic-condition medication and check blood pressure
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Wash face with soap and water. Dry face with towel. Brush teeth with toothpaste. Rinse mouth. Take morning medication with water. Check blood pressure with monitor. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Get dressed for the on-site clinic and school shift, read one-on-one text messages on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Put on clothes. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Read text messages. Type reply. Send reply. Put down phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Boil kettle, make breakfast with toaster, feed the dog, eat breakfast standing at the counter
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Press button to boil. Open cupboard. Take out bread. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Open dog food container. Scoop dog food into bowl. Place bowl on floor. Wait for toast. Pick up toast. Spread butter. Eat toast. Drink water. Rinse cup.

enriched_activities.activity: School run and drop-off, then leash the dog for the walk to the bus stop
enriched_activities.desc: Leave house. Walk to school with child. Arrive at school. Say goodbye to child. Walk back home. Enter house. Pick up dog leash. Attach leash to dog collar. Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Arrive at bus stop.

enriched_activities.activity: Walk the dog along the neighbourhood route while waiting for the bus
enriched_activities.desc: Walk along sidewalk. Dog sniffs ground. Stop at corner. Wait for traffic light. Cross street. Walk past park. Dog urinates. Continue walking. Return to bus stop. Check phone for time. Look at bus schedule. Wait for bus.

enriched_activities.activity: Public transit commute to the clinic, reading appointment notes on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Take out phone. Open notes app. Scroll through appointment notes. Read notes. Look up at stop. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk to clinic.

enriched_activities.activity: On-site clinic shift: patient intake, scheduled health appointments, blood pressure and medication checks
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at clinic. Clock in. Put on badge. Open computer. Review patient list. Call first patient. Greet patient. Ask about symptoms. Measure blood pressure. Record results. Discuss medication. Update records. Schedule follow-up. Call next patient. Repeat.

enriched_activities.activity: Lunch break at the clinic, quick one-on-one text exchange with a relative
enriched_activities.desc: Go to break room. Open lunch bag. Take out sandwich. Eat sandwich. Take out phone. Open messaging app. Select relative. Type message. Send message. Receive reply. Read reply. Type response. Send response. Finish eating. Throw away trash.

enriched_activities.activity: Community health visits to nearby households, recording notes on phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to first house. Knock on door. Greet resident. Introduce self. Enter house. Wash hands. Check blood pressure. Measure pulse. Ask health questions. Discuss medication. Provide advice. Record notes on phone. Schedule next visit. Say goodbye. Walk to next house. Repeat.

enriched_activities.activity: Primary school aide duties: classroom supervision, reading support and tidy-up
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at school. Enter classroom. Greet teacher. Check attendance. Supervise children. Hand out materials. Help child read. Listen to reading. Correct pronunciation. Assist with worksheet. Collect books. Organize supplies. Tidy up shelves. Wipe tables. Stack chairs.

enriched_activities.activity: Finish clinic paperwork and update community contact records
enriched_activities.desc: Return to clinic. Open computer. Open patient records. Update contact info. Check emails. Respond to messages. Print forms. File papers. Organize desk. Lock files. Close computer. Log out.

enriched_activities.activity: Public transit commute home
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit. Take out phone. Check messages. Read news. Look out window. Arrive at stop. Stand. Exit bus. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Walk the dog on the local loop before going inside
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive home. Greet dog. Pick up leash. Attach to collar. Walk out. Walk along loop. Dog sniffs. Stop at tree. Continue. Return home. Remove leash. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Cook dinner with the induction cooker, reheat rice, take evening medication
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open fridge. Take out vegetables. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Open microwave. Place rice bowl. Press reheat. Take out medication bottle. Open. Take pill. Swallow with water.

enriched_activities.activity: Eat dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to dining room. Sit at table. Serve food. Pick up fork. Cut food. Eat food. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Take sip. Wipe mouth. Finish. Pick up plate. Stand up. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Wash up, load the dishwasher, wipe benches and pack tomorrow's lunch
enriched_activities.desc: Scrape food into bin. Rinse plates. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close door. Press start. Wipe counter with cloth. Open fridge. Take out lunch container. Place sandwich. Add fruit. Close container. Put in fridge.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening dog walk around the block
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up leash. Attach to dog. Open door. Walk out. Lock door. Walk around block. Dog sniffs. Stop. Continue. Return. Unlock door. Enter. Remove leash.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV while sending detailed one-on-one text check-ins to relatives and neighbours
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Open phone. Open messaging app. Select relative. Type message. Send. Watch TV. Receive reply. Read. Type response. Send. Change channel.

enriched_activities.activity: Shower, dry off, take night medication and set out tomorrow's clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step in. Wet body. Apply soap. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Pick up medication. Open. Take pill. Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Select clothes. Lay out on chair.

enriched_activities.activity: Desk lamp on, watching TV and journaling, planning tomorrow's appointments and transit times
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on TV. Sit at desk. Open journal. Pick up pen. Write. Open phone. Check calendar. Write down appointments. Check transit app. Write times. Close journal. Turn off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, light off and phone silenced
enriched_activities.desc: Turn off desk lamp. Turn off TV. Pick up phone. Silence phone. Place on charger. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Remain still. Adjust pillow. Sleep.
